## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend lint passes (`ruff check app tests`)
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`pytest`)
- [ ] Frontend build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Retrieval benchmark updated when retrieval behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` updated when configuration changed

## RAG impact

Describe any effect on ingestion, retrieval, ranking, prompts, citations, latency,
or model cost. Include before-and-after evaluation metrics when applicable.

## Security and privacy

Confirm that the change does not commit credentials, generated indexes, or
private documents, and note any new data sent to external providers.
